hsm.title: Highway Safety Manual
hsm.decided: critical rate against the corridor's own sites (user, #34 item 7, docs/03); used in every state until that state's own screening is built

crash_costs.missing: IDOT publishes costs per person killed or injured, not per crash (2024 Crash Facts p. 23: fatality $2,009,575, A-injury $171,925, B $45,300, C $27,795, property damage crash $6,485, from National Safety Council 2024 estimates); its only per-crash table is 1999-2003, marked 'reference only' (Safety 1-06, p. 225). Pricing a crash by its worst injury with per-person costs would be wrong, so no cost column until IDOT's current HSIP benefit-cost crash costs are found

statewide_rates.missing: IDOT's only published statewide averages here are fatal and A-injury crashes per 100 centerline miles for rural collectors and local roads (Safety 1-06, p. 7, high-risk rural roads), not crash rates per vehicle-mile; and CrashIQ has no Illinois traffic counts

screening.state_method: IDOT screens by peer group with frequency, rate and EPDO critical values (Safety 1-06 HSIP candidate form, 'HALIS Peer Group ... Critical Values Exceeded: Freq Rate EPDO', p. 252) and the 5% report

min_years.page: p. 8: 'five years of crash data should be used for the analysis' (also p. 7 table note: 'a minimum of 5 most recent years of crash data'); written for HSIP analyses

spf_calibration.missing: IDOT's SPF and calibration work is not published in Safety 1-06; not loaded (no SPF engine)
